title: Number system: practice set 2
sourceNote: Original practice questions written for this group. None of them is a CAT previous-year question.
instructions: 6 questions, 12 minutes, CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

questions.text: What is the smallest three-digit number that leaves a remainder of 3 when divided by 4, by 6 and by 9?
How many odd factors does 720 have?
What is the remainder when 2¹⁰⁰ is divided by 7?
A two-digit number is 4 times the sum of its digits. If 18 is added to it, its digits are reversed. What is the number?
What is the units digit of 7³⁵ × 3²²?
How many whole numbers from 1 to 100 are divisible by 3 or by 5?
